blocks.text: SOP: outbound load at doors 1-4

This is the working cut for PCF-SOP-2024-058 on May 30, 2024. Ben Crowe asked for a written bound after the current path (Seals in a drawer, photos skipped when the line is long) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host dock.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on seal later from the office, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

BOL, seal photo, lean check. Chocks in. No live load without a spotter if a jack is on the plate. I am not restating a hallway yes. seal later from the office is out because May 9 office seal did not match the trailer. Carrier disputed 4 pallets. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: doors=4, pallets=4, photos=1, weeks=2, chocks=1, dispute=1, seal=1.2, line=14. Sibling tickets PCF-1802 and PCF-SOP-2024-064. I will not reopen seal later from the office in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: wms.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (13): refuse on seal later from the office, lock is seal photo at door, BOL, chocks, spotter on plate. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-1802.
A trailer that leaves without a seal number is not loaded. It is a story.

What a skeptical lead would try first on dock.pinecrest.internal: the path Ben Crowe actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on door-01.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock
